definitions.explanation: Words, actions, or things that bring comfort or relief to someone who is sad, suffering, or distressed.
Something that provides entertainment or distraction from boredom or hardship.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{言葉|ことば}が{慰|なぐさ}めになった。
examples.english: Her words were a comfort to me.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}からの{慰|なぐさ}めの{手紙|てがみ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read a letter of consolation from a friend.

examples.japanese: どんな{慰|なぐさ}めの{言葉|ことば}をかけても、{彼|かれ}の{悲|かな}しみは{消|き}えなかった。
examples.english: No matter what words of comfort I offered, his sadness wouldn't go away.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}が{唯一|ゆいいつ}の{慰|なぐさ}めだった。
{読書|どくしょ}は{日々|ひび}の{慰|なぐさ}めになっている。
examples.english: Reading serves as a daily diversion.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしの{祖母|そぼ}にとって、{猫|ねこ}が{大|おお}きな{慰|なぐさ}めになっている。
examples.english: For my grandmother who lives alone, her cat is a great source of comfort.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {慰|なぐさ}める (to comfort, to console). Can refer both to emotional consolation and to things that serve as amusement or solace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰|なぐさ}めの{言葉|ことば}: words of comfort
- {慰|なぐさ}めになる: to serve as consolation/comfort
- {気休|きやす}めの{慰|なぐさ}め: hollow comfort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {癒|いや}し: healing, soothing — focuses on therapeutic relief
- {励|はげ}まし: encouragement — focuses on motivating someone forward
- {慰安|いあん}: comfort, recreation — more formal; often used in compounds like {慰安旅行|いあんりょこう} (company trip)
